title: Type IV minor pilin ComN predicted the USS-receptor in Pasteurellaceae.
authors: Helsem, Stian Aleksander; Alfsnes, Kristian; Frye, Stephan A; Lovestad, Alexander Hesselberg; Ambur, Ole Herman
one_liner_zh: 该文通过AlphaFold3结构建模、几何深度学习DeepPBS及分子动力学模拟，预测Pasteurellaceae中PpdA/ComN为USS受体，核心聚焦蛋白-DNA特异性结合识别与机制，方法高度契合本课题。
abstract: The Uptake Signal Sequence (USS) receptor, which facilitates the acquisition of homologous DNA by natural transformation in Haemophilus influenzae and other members of the Pasteurellaceae, remains unknown. Through discriminating functional gene ontology assessment, cellular localization predictions, and deep-learning structural modeling of protein-DNA complexes, prepilin peptidase-dependent protein A (PpdA) was identified as the strongest USS receptor candidate in different Pasteurellaceae family members with divergent USS specificities. Pasteurellaceae PpdA (PpdA(Past)) was the only orthogroup modeled by AlphaFold3 (AF3) to form specific complexes with USS significantly better than complexes with sequence-scrambled versions of USS. Further analyses of PpdA-USS complexes using geometric deep learning protein-DNA sequence specificity predictions and coevolution analyses were found to further support PpdA as the USS receptor candidate in 10 different Pasteurellaceae enriched with divergent USS dialects. PpdA(Past) was predicted to possess USS-binding specificity by DeepPBS and was found to strongly coevolve with USS relative to other orthogroups. PpdA(Past) was found to share both structural features and functionally involved electropositive residues with other DNA-binding minor pilins and the largely unexplored Escherichia coli/Enterobacteriaceae PpdA ortholog. One robust DNA-binding mode was identified with two alternative and opposite USS orientations. Combining modeled PpdA-USS proximity and coevolved signals revealed how the C-terminal region of PpdA(Past) fitted one of two 180 degrees alternative USS orientations. Root Mean Square Deviations (RMSDs) from molecular dynamics simulations of PpdA(Past) USS complexes found reliable structures under 3 A in moderately stable trajectories. The ppdA gene, previously documented as essential for transformation and constituting part of the competence regulon in Haemophilus influenzae and E. coli, was found in a conserved genomic location with conserved operonic organization across the Pasteurellaceae. Together, the in silico results of this study and the documented knock out phenotype make a strong case for PpdA(Past) as the USS-receptor and provide future directions for recombinant PpdA(Past) assays and in vivo experiments with mutants. Here, we propose ComN for use with these PpdA(Past) orthologs in compliance with the previously assigned gene name and the predicted central role in competence as a DNA receptor with USS specificity.
abstract_zh: 摄取信号序列（USS）受体，在流感嗜血杆菌及其他巴氏杆菌科成员中通过自然转化促进同源DNA的获取，但其身份仍属未知。通过判别性功能基因本体评估、细胞定位预测以及蛋白质-DNA复合物的深度学习结构建模，前菌毛肽酶依赖性蛋白A（PpdA）被鉴定为不同巴氏杆菌科成员中具有不同USS特异性的最强USS受体候选。巴氏杆菌科PpdA（PpdA(Past)）是唯一被AlphaFold3（AF3）建模的正交群，其与USS形成的特异性复合物显著优于与序列打乱版USS形成的复合物。利用几何深度学习蛋白质-DNA序列特异性预测和共进化分析对PpdA-USS复合物的进一步分析，进一步支持PpdA作为10种富含不同USS方言的巴氏杆菌科中的USS受体候选。DeepPBS预测PpdA(Past)具有USS结合特异性，并发现其与其他正交群相比，与USS强烈共进化。PpdA(Past)被发现与其他DNA结合小菌毛蛋白及尚未充分探索的大肠杆菌/肠杆菌科PpdA同源物共享结构特征和功能相关的正电荷残基。鉴定出一种稳健的DNA结合模式，具有两种交替且相反的USS方向。结合建模的PpdA-USS邻近性和共进化信号，揭示了PpdA(Past)的C端区域如何适配两种180度交替USS方向之一。来自PpdA(Past) USS复合物分子动力学模拟的均方根偏差（RMSDs）在中等稳定轨迹下发现可靠结构低于3 Å。ppdA基因，先前被记录为流感嗜血杆菌和大肠杆菌中转化所必需并构成感受态调节子的一部分，被发现位于保守的基因组位置，并在巴氏杆菌科中具有保守的操纵子组织。综合本研究的计算机模拟结果和已记录的敲除表型，为PpdA(Past)作为USS受体提供了有力证据，并为重组PpdA(Past)检测和突变体体内实验提供了未来方向。在此，我们提议将ComN用于这些PpdA(Past)同源物，以符合先前分配的基因名称及其作为具有USS特异性的DNA受体在感受态中的预测核心作用。
